subject: Token economics recap + startup & committed-use options for Helio Labs
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Asha Kapoor <asha@heliolabs.com>, Diego Ramos <diego@heliolabs.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps (token estimates, budget range, startup eligibility)

Hi Asha / Diego —

Great demo earlier — thanks for the time. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we can model pricing and check startup program eligibility: 

1) Your estimated token profile (please confirm):
   - Pilot (next 2 months): ~10M tokens / month
   - Production ramp (3–12 months): 20M -> 80M tokens / month
   - Peak (year 2 target): ~120M tokens / month

2) Budget & target unit economics:
   - You mentioned a target of ~$350–450 per 1M tokens as a target blended cost. Confirm whether the $/1M target is pre-discount or post any startup credits.

3) Discount asks to validate:
   - Startup program / credits (seed-stage eligibility)
   - Committed-use pricing for 1-year and 3-year terms (would like modeled % off + any multi-year incentives)

4) Info we need from Helio to produce scenarios (small ask):
   - Expected monthly token table for next 12 months (attach if you have it)
   - Finance contact for procurement/PO process

Attachments: I’ve attached the recording + the simple token-estimate sheet I used during the call (helio-token-estimates.xlsx).

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm the numbers above and share any adjustments to the ramp.
- We’ll put together 3 pricing scenarios (no-commit hosted, 1-year commit, 3-year commit + max startup credit applied) with projected blended $/1M and monthly Opex.
- Quick follow-up call to review the scenarios — suggest Wed 3/20 10:00am PT (open to other times).

Thanks — looping in Soojin (pricing) and Neha (startup program) to expedite.

Best,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
--
Attachment stubs:
- hl-demo-recording.mp4 (video, 78MB)

From: Asha Kapoor <asha@heliolabs.com>

Cc: Diego Ramos <diego@heliolabs.com>, Priya Sundar <priya@heliolabs.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps (token estimates, budget range, startup eligibility)

Thanks Logan — good walkthrough. A few clarifications and the initial numbers you can use: 

- Confirmed ramp (rough):
  * Month 1–2 (pilot): 8–12M / month
  * Months 3–6: 20–40M / month (mainly chat + retrieval flows)
  * Months 7–12: 40–80M / month (expanded feature set)

- Internal budget note: finance is currently allocating $120k–$220k / month for inference in year 1 (this is flexible if committed discounts make sense).

- Our target blended price point: ideally ~$320–380 per 1M tokens once credits/discounts applied. If committed pricing can get us to ~$300/1M blended, that would be attractive.

- Startup eligibility: Helio is seed-stage but we closed our seed 6 months ago; happy to provide cap table and incorporation docs for verification.

I attached our procurement questionnaire (procurement_qs_helio.pdf) — Priya (cc) will own the procurement thread and can join the pricing review call.

Let us know if you want us to fill any template numbers into your sheet or prefer you populate scenarios first. Wednesday 3/20 10am PT works for Diego and me.

—Asha
Asha Kapoor
Co-founder & Head of Product
Helio Labs

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Asha Kapoor <asha@heliolabs.com>, Diego Ramos <diego@heliolabs.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Priya Sundar <priya@heliolabs.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps (token estimates, budget range, startup eligibility)

Asha / Diego —

Thanks for the detail and for looping Priya in. Quick note on how we’ll frame scenarios for Wed’s call and what the startup program typically looks like so you can plan with Finance: 

Pricing scenarios (high level) we’ll model:
- Option A — On-demand (no commit): base hosted API pricing, prefix & batching optimizations included, useful for pilot.
- Option B — 1-year committed use: typically a stepped discount structure (example: 20% off list at your expected 20–60M band), with a monthly billing commitment.
- Option C — 3-year committed use + multi-year incentive: deeper discount (example: 30–40% off depending on volume bands) and eligibility for additional credits for platform onboarding and support.

Startup program note (Neha):
- Seed-stage startups often qualify for a package that includes a one-time onboarding credit (applied first), and priority access to trial Dedicated capacity.
- Credits reduce near-term cash outlay but are applied before committed-use discounting in our modeled examples (we’ll show both pre-credit and post-credit blended $/1M).

Target blended ranges we’ll aim to show for your numbers:
- No commit: ~$520–620 / 1M tokens (example for no-discount hosted profile)
- 1yr commit: ~$380–430 / 1M (depends on exact commit size and bowling of volumes)
- 3yr commit + startup credits: ~$260–340 / 1M (with higher commits & multi-year incentives)

Please treat those as illustrative — we’ll run the model with the exact month-by-month ramp you provided and show blended Opex. If Helio prefers a target of ~$300/1M, we’ll model the minimum committed level (and any tradeoffs like reserved capacity vs burst).

Deliverables before Wed 3/20 call: 
- Pricing scenarios PDF (attached: redwood-pricing-scenarios.pdf)
- Modeled monthly cashflow and blended $/1M (I’ll populate helio-token-estimates.xlsx and share a Drive link)
- A short list of contractual items Finance will want (SLA, invoice cadence, PO requirements, data residency notes)

Logistics: confirmed — Wed 3/20 10:00am PT. I’ll send a calendar invite and include a brief agenda. If Priya wants to push an earlier time for Finance, let me know.

Thanks — looking forward to tightening the numbers.

Best,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
--
Attachment stubs:
- redwood-pricing-scenarios.pdf (PDF, 34KB)
- helio-token-estimates.xlsx (updated for modeling, spreadsheet, 14KB)
